$description: Port definitions for benchmark-parity SLD symbols. All coordinates are relative to viewBox 100x100.

transformer_3w.notes: Rotation limited due to asymmetric port layout

pv.notes: Rotation limited - sun arrow must point to panel

fw.notes: Rotation limited - turbine orientation is standard

bess.description: Magazyn energii / Battery Energy Storage System

utility_feeder.notes: Rotation limited - arrows must point down toward network

ground.notes: Rotation not allowed - ground symbol must point down

earthing_switch.notes: Single port — blade connects to ground symbol below

surge_arrester.notes: Single port — ground symbol integrated at bottom

motor.notes: Circle with M — single connection port at top

load.notes: Downward triangle — single connection port at top

ring_busbar.description: Szyna pierścieniowa / Ring busbar (S1+S2 z zamknięciem ring) — IEC 60617
ring_busbar.notes: Two parallel busbar sections connected via right-side ring closure. Section identifiers S1 (top) and S2 (bottom).

double_busbar.description: Szyna dwusystemowa / Double busbar (S1+S2 independent) — IEC 60617
double_busbar.notes: Two independent parallel busbars (main S1 + auxiliary S2). Operator selects which system per bay; coupler is a separate symbol.

busbar_section_marker.description: Oznaczenie sekcji szyn / Busbar section marker — IEC 60617
busbar_section_marker.notes: Inline section separator on a busbar (does not interrupt electrical continuity unless paired with a coupler).

cb_drawout.description: Wyłącznik wyciągalny / Drawout circuit breaker — IEC 60617-4-30
cb_drawout.notes: Withdrawable circuit breaker in racked compartment (ABB UniGear-class / Siemens 8DJH-class — vendor binding requires datasheet verification, see SLD_INDUSTRIAL_SCADA_CAD_TARGET.md § 3.3).

busbar_coupler.description: Sprzęgło sekcji szyn / Busbar coupler — IEC 60617
busbar_coupler.notes: Connects two busbar sections (S1 left, S2 right) via DS + CB + DS sequence. Used in double_busbar topology for transferring loads between systems.

auto_recloser.notes: Circuit breaker with auto-reclose function (ANSI 79). Used on overhead MV feeders to clear transient faults automatically.

switch_3pos.notes: Three-position disconnector/earthing switch (typical for SF6 GIS modules). Combines disconnector and earthing function in one apparatus — interlocked to prevent invalid states.

alarm_marker.description: Znacznik alarmu / Alarm marker (decorative overlay, not a connection symbol)
alarm_marker.notes: Visual overlay only — no electrical connection ports. Used as annotation badge on elements with active alarms. Non-standard viewBox 24x24 (decorative marker).

missing_data_marker.description: Znacznik braku danych / Missing data marker (decorative overlay)
missing_data_marker.notes: Visual overlay only — no electrical connection ports. Used as annotation badge on elements with incomplete catalog data. Non-standard viewBox 24x24.

cable_head_triangle.notes: Cable termination at top of pole or in switchgear. Single connection port at top vertex (where cable attaches). Non-standard viewBox 22x22 (legacy symbol; normalization to 100x100 deferred to F1 sprint 4b).

cable_joint.notes: Inline cable splice/joint — does not interrupt continuity. Non-standard viewBox 16x16 (legacy symbol).

load_switch.description: Rozłącznik SN / Load break switch — IEC 60617
load_switch.notes: Load break switch (rozłącznik z bezpiecznikiem). Can interrupt load current but NOT fault current — see SI-100 eligibility check (does not count as protectable apparatus for overcurrent analysis). Non-standard viewBox 46x64 (legacy symbol).

nop.description: Normalnie Otwarty Punkt / Normally Open Point — IEC 60617
nop.notes: Normally Open Point — break in ring/loop topology. Two vertical lines with NO badge. Non-standard viewBox 32x32 (legacy symbol).

pole.description: Słup linii napowietrznej / Overhead line pole — IEC 60617
pole.notes: Overhead line support pole. Used for routing trunk SN through countryside terrain. Non-standard viewBox 24x36.

zksn.description: Złącze kablowe SN / Cable junction box MV (ZK SN) — IEC 60617
zksn.notes: MV cable junction box (Polish: Złącze Kablowe SN). 4-way connector for branch points on MV cable network. Non-standard viewBox 32x32 (legacy symbol).

lightning_rod.notes: Lightning protection rod with permanent earth connection. Mounted at GPZ or substation top.

grounding_resistor.notes: Neutral grounding resistor. Limits ground fault current in transformer neutral or grounding transformer. Bottom is earth (not routed).

grounding_reactor.description: Dławik uziemiający (cewka Petersena) / Grounding reactor (Petersen coil) — IEC 60617
grounding_reactor.notes: Petersen coil for compensated MV networks. Tuned to network capacitance to suppress ground fault current.

synchrocheck.description: Przekaźnik synchrocheck / Synchronism check relay — IEC 60617 + ANSI 25
synchrocheck.notes: Synchrocheck (ANSI 25) — verifies voltage / frequency / phase angle synchronism before closing a CB. Two measurement inputs (one per side of CB).

surge_arrester_10ka.description: Ogranicznik przepięć 10 kA / Surge arrester 10 kA — IEC 60617
surge_arrester_10ka.notes: Surge arrester with explicit 10 kA discharge current rating (In). Common MV rating per IEC 60099. Bottom is earth (not routed).

autotransformer.notes: Single-winding autotransformer with shared neutral. Used for HV/HV voltage adaptation (e.g. 220/110 kV). Tap connection on side.

transformer_tap_changer.description: Transformator 2W z OLTC (On-Load Tap Changer) / TR2W z regulacją pod obciążeniem — IEC 60617
transformer_tap_changer.notes: Two-winding transformer with on-load tap changer (OLTC). Used in GPZ for voltage regulation. Tap range typically ±10% in 1.25% steps.

utility_source.description: Sieć zewnętrzna (External Grid) / Utility source — IEC 60617
utility_source.notes: External transmission grid connection point (Point of Common Coupling at HV bus). Represents Thevenin equivalent of upstream network in solver_input. Typically HV side of GPZ (110 kV or higher).

pv_inverter_nc_rfg.description: Falownik PV z NC RfG compliance / PV inverter NC RfG-compliant — IEC 60617 + Reg. (EU) 2016/631
pv_inverter_nc_rfg.notes: PV inverter compliant with NC RfG (Annex II Reg. (EU) 2016/631). DC input from PV array, AC output to grid. Profile (FRT/Q-U/cos φ(P)) per operator YAML in backend/src/catalog/profiles/nc_rfg/{operator}.yaml. Default operator: ENEA (per /goal V12K).

wind_turbine_full_converter.description: Turbina wiatrowa full-converter (Type 4) / Wind turbine full-converter — IEC 61400
wind_turbine_full_converter.notes: Wind turbine generator Type 4 (full-converter AC-DC-AC). Decoupled from grid via converter — provides flexibility for NC RfG compliance (FRT, Q-U, ramp rate).
